opus.why: Simple weather lookup via web search; nothing to reason about.

fable.why: Single web lookup and a one-line relay of the forecast; no judgment involved.

opus.why: Codebase search for a definition. It may sit under an alias or in a re-export, so it needs a few grep passes, but it isn't hard.

fable.why: Codebase grep for a symbol that isn't where expected; needs a few persistent searches (re-exports, aliases) but no design judgment. Medium so it doesn't stop after one search.

opus.why: Factual web lookup of the Node release schedule.

fable.why: Factual web lookup of the Node release schedule; trivial to read and report.

opus.why: The log shows the cause plainly: the DB goes read-only at 03:00 while the slow export is still running, and every retry also lands inside that window. Haiku can explain this and suggest moving the job or its backoff.

fable.why: The log already states the cause: the 03:00 read-only maintenance window breaks the status UPDATE. Reading and explaining it is trivial.

opus.why: Listing the brand books is easy, but spotting the old logo means looking at images or PDFs and judging what's visible. Haiku is more likely to miss or misjudge it.

fable.why: Finding files is easy, but deciding which still contain the old logo may require viewing images and brand/visual judgment, where Haiku could misclassify.

opus.why: Pricing research across several sources in Europe, plus a judgment on whether local video generation is worth it. That needs synthesis beyond a single lookup.

fable.why: Multi-search price research with a short synthesis; medium so it actually runs several searches and compares rather than stopping early.

opus.why: Three-line summary of a short pasted file, just for the user's own notes.

fable.why: Three-line summary of a short, well-structured script; internal note, not audience copy.

opus.why: Read-only inventory run while the user is away: count files per scene and check their dates. It has to work out the scene naming without help, so low effort risks stopping early.

fable.why: Read-only directory inventory with counts per scene and age filter; a few shell commands plus strict 'don't move anything' instruction following.

opus.why: Follow-up lookup of one pharmacy's Sunday hours.

fable.why: Follow-up to a simple local lookup; one web search for the corner pharmacy's Sunday hours.
